Question 16
?

Find the equation of the right-opening parabola that has its vertex at (−1,1) and passes through the point (8,7).

a
(y−1)2=4(x+1)
b
(y−1)2=−4(x+1)
c
(y−1)2=−2(x+1)
d
(y+1)2=4(x−1)
e
(y−1)2=2(x+1)
